那就不是两个人加起来那么简单了。你们一起能做到的，会比两个人分开做，多得多！.english: Then it isn’t just adding two people together. What you can achieve together is much more than what you could do separately!

我看外面的房子。她说的“更好”，不只是再多救一个人。也可能是，让另外一个人不用什.english: I look at the buildings outside. Her idea of “better” isn’t just saving one more person. It might also mean making sure someone else doesn’t have to do everything alone.
